title: Exporting Your Client IDs from Google Workspace

blocks.text: You can export a list of client IDs of all the apps connected to your Google environment and upload the apps to the Inventory in Zscaler 3rd-Party App Governance using the client IDs.
Google Workspace admins can navigate to App Access Control and find all the third-party apps connected to their Google environment.

Any Google user can navigate to account security settings and information and find the apps with access to their account. There you can find the list of apps with access to your Google account data and apps using your Google account for sign-in. You can copy the app name and search for it in the Inventory.
In your Gmail inbox, you can find the apps that have accessed your inbox. Go to your Gmail inbox, scroll to the bottom of the page, and click the Details button.
